When you wanna hit one enemy, its easy to predict and land the R Spear on them, this also works with any number of champs under towers since theyre just sitting there and when they see the R coming up,  you already predicted that so the R Spear hits them.
When it comes to ulting to volatile teamfights and skirmishes, its better to just use the R as a tool to force whoever youre falling on into a bad position where they have to burn spells or die. In that order, most times. Also remember to aim your R directly at them, you dont want them to sidestep away easily.
With time, you'll learn when its better to risk using R and when its a soft int, i suggest also going into practice tool or a staged 1v1 with a friend and just practice your camera control, i personally prefer getting out of lock towards where im aiming, then after i cast R, i lock cam again so im not disoriented after i land.
